description: CallRail call tracking — calls with source, campaign, keyword and lead status; tracking numbers; form submissions

callrail_calls.description: One row per call: attribution, outcome, lead status, hashed caller

callrail_calls_daily.description: View: calls, answered, first-time callers and qualified leads by day, source and campaign

callrail_trackers.description: Tracking numbers and the source each one represents

callrail_form_submissions.description: Tracked form submissions (only if the account has form tracking)

calls_by_source_30d.description: Calls and qualified leads by source, last 30 days
calls_by_source_30d.sql: SELECT source, SUM(calls) AS calls, SUM(answered) AS answered, SUM(first_time_callers) AS new_callers, SUM(qualified_leads) AS leads FROM callrail_calls_daily WHERE date >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY source ORDER BY calls DESC

missed_calls.description: Unanswered calls in the last 7 days
missed_calls.sql: SELECT start_time, source_name, campaign, voicemail FROM callrail_calls WHERE answered = 0 AND call_date >= date('now', '-7 days') ORDER BY start_time DESC

api_integration.rate_limits: Hourly and daily request caps; the client backs off on 429 using Retry-After
